info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Rules-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules API allows users to access the rules governing the allocation of loyalty points within the hotel loyalty program. This API enables hotel managers and developers to retrieve detailed information about existing point rules, which can vary based on stay duration, room type, and promotional events. Typically consumed by hotel management systems and travel applications, this API facilitates effective customer engagement and reward management. By utilizing this information, organizations can fine-tune their loyalty offerings to enhance customer retention and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current rules associated with points. These rules govern how points are earned, redeemed, and managed within the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters and conditions for retrieving point rules. It should contain the necessary attributes to properly filter and retrieve the desired rules related to points.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the rules for points.
